title: Hermes AI agent used to automate attack on Thai Finance Ministry

title: Chick-fil-A data breach affects more than 13,000 customers
description: Chick-fil-A has confirmed that over 13,000 customers had their accounts breached in a wave of credential stuffing attacks targeting its website and mobile app between June 17 and June 19. [...]

title: Slopsquatting, Phantom Domains, and HalluSquatting Are the Same AI Attack
description: Slopsquatting, phantom squatting, and HalluSquatting all exploit the same late-binding attack pattern, where AI coding agents trust hallucinated package, repo, or domain names. ActiveState explains how pre-fetch verification and governed dependency management can help stop these attacks before malicious code enters the pipeline. [...]
